holidays.name: National Gumdrop Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the squishy, sugar-coated, jewel-toned gumdrop. Pop a few, bake them into treats, or build a tiny gumdrop village and call it art.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has become a staple of the sweet-treat calendar.
holidays.funFact: Gumdrops are made with a gelatin or pectin base. That gives them a firmer chew than jelly beans and lets them hold their shape well enough to decorate gingerbread houses.

holidays.name: Annoy Squidward Day
holidays.description: A day for SpongeBob SquarePants fans to channel their inner SpongeBob and Patrick. Fans celebrate by being cheerfully, relentlessly noisy around the grumpiest neighbor in Bikini Bottom. Clarinet solos are optional but encouraged.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial, fan-driven pop culture observance of unclear origin. It honors Squidward Tentacles, the long-suffering cashier from the Nickelodeon cartoon.
holidays.funFact: Squidward lives in a moai-shaped house right next to SpongeBob's pineapple. That makes him the perfect target for a day about annoying your neighbor.

holidays.name: National Hippo Day
holidays.description: A day to appreciate one of the world's most underrated animals. Hippos look like big, round, sleepy water-puppies, but they are among Africa's most dangerous animals.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It encourages people to learn about and appreciate hippos.
holidays.funFact: Hippos secrete a reddish, oily fluid that acts like a natural sunscreen and moisturizer. This is why people used to say they sweat blood.
